relationships.subject: DNMT3a/DNMT3b
relationships.evidence_quote: De novo DNMTs, DNMT3a and DNMT3b, add new methylation marks on previously unmethylated CpG sites.

relationships.subject: p300/CBP
relationships.evidence_quote: The acetyl group is transferred by histones acetyl transferases (HATs), such as p300/CBP (CREB (cAMP response element-binding) binding protein), using acetyl CoA as a cofactor

relationships.subject: HDACs
relationships.evidence_quote: Erasers of the acetylation mark are histone deacetylases (HDACs)

key_findings: Review of DNA methylation, histone modification and ncRNA mechanisms in chronic pain across DRG, spinal cord and brain.
Causal evidence and cell-type-specific, brain-region studies of pain epigenetics remain limited.
